{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to float, removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Count them
total_qa = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders: {total_qa}")

# Check if they are in the 'converted' group
qa_converted = df[qa_mask]['converted'].value_counts()
print(f"QA orders in 'converted' group: {qa_converted}")

# Now, filter for converted customers, excluding QA orders
converted_df = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (~qa_mask)]

# Check how many converted customers remain
print("Number of real converted customers (after removing QA):", len(converted_df))

# Check age distribution for real converted customers
print("Age distribution for real converted customers:")
print(converted_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Compute mean age, excluding -1 (missing)
mean_age_clean = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean age of real converted customers (excluding -1 and QA): {mean_age_clean}")"}
